description: This file defines the OrderSetDAO interface, which specifies database operations related to OrderSet entities within the OpenMRS project, including methods for CRUD operations and retrieval of associated attribute types and attributes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an OrderSet object to the database.

methods.name: getOrderSets
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderSet objects, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getOrderSetById
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSet by its integer ID.

methods.name: getOrderSetByUniqueUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSet by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetMemberByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetMember by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttribute by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves an OrderSetAttributeType by its name.
